'''The Insatiable''' is a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|The Insatiable}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Liquify Ground
|Intent = Buff, StatusCard
|Effect = Gains 4 {{BD2|Sandpit}} (counted separately for each player). Shuffles 6 {{C2|Frantic Escape}} into each player's deck (3 into draw pile, 3 into discard pile).
|GivesToEnemy = Sandpit
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Thrash
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage ×2.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Lunging Bite
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (28;{{Asc2|9|31}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Salivate
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains (2;{{Asc2|9|3}}) {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Insatiable always opens with {{Int2|The Insatiable|Liquify Ground}}, then repeats the following cycle:
# {{Int2|The Insatiable|Thrash}}
# {{Int2|The Insatiable|Lunging Bite}}
# {{Int2|The Insatiable|Salivate}}
# {{Int2|The Insatiable|Thrash}}
# Back to the first {{Int|The Insatiable|Thrash||2|Enemy Name=|Move Name=}}

== Notes ==
* {{BD2|Sandpit}} acts like a {{2|Debuffs|Debuff}} on each player, it was likely placed on '''The Insatiable''' to improve visibility of the debuff
* {{P2|Fairy in a Bottle}} will not prevent the death stemming from {{BD2|Sandpit}}

== Useful Cards ==
* {{C2|Iteration}} will trigger consistently during this battle because the player's deck starts with six copies of {{C2|Frantic Escape}} shuffled in.
* {{C2|Flak Cannon}} will hit an additional six times the first time it is played, but using it can be very risky because you will be left with no way to gain more {{BD2|Sandpit}} through {{C2|Frantic Escape|Frantic Escapes}}.
